documents.title: AGENTS.md
documents.raw_content: AGENTS.md is the single source of truth for agent guidance in the minibox repository. CLAUDE.md is a pointer to this file and must not duplicate its rules. Minibox is a Rust 2024 Docker-like container runtime with a daemon/CLI split, OCI image support, Linux namespace/cgroup isolation, overlay filesystems, and macOS adapter backends. cargo xtask verify runs fmt check, workspace check, clippy -D warnings, feature matrix, architecture rings, borrow fixtures, docs audit; it is read-only and safe on a dirty tree. cargo xtask pre-commit runs clippy -D warnings and architecture on every commit, and cargo fmt --all only when Rust is staged. cargo xtask prepush runs release build, release nextest, and conformance before pushing. cargo fmt --all without --check rewrites all workspace .rs files including untracked ones, which can clobber another writer's uncommitted changes; use --check in that case. Branches follow the stability pipeline develop -> staging -> release -> main -> v* tag. develop is the default working branch. Run git branch --show-current before every commit; if the answer is main, STOP. Never commit unless explicitly asked. Stage explicit paths; never git add -A in a shared tree. main is protected via GitHub rulesets; staging and release block force pushes and deletions and require CI passed. Domain ports live under crates/minibox-domain/src/; minibox_core::domain and minibox::domain are compatibility re-exports. minibox re-exports minibox-core. DaemonRequest/DaemonResponse are canonical in crates/minibox-core/src/protocol.rs. DaemonResponse::ContainerOutput is non-terminal. HandlerDependencies changes require updating all adapter suite construction sites in crates/miniboxd/src/main.rs. Security invariants: preserve tar extraction protections (reject .., absolute symlinks, device nodes, FIFOs, setuid/setgid bits); keep overlay/path validation inside the target root; preserve native-adapter SO_PEERCRED checks and root-only access; enforce image pull size limits; container init must use execve with explicit env, not execvp. Rust edition is 2024; std::env::set_var and remove_var are unsafe and must be serialized with a shared lock. Tasks live in .ctx/godmode/tasks.yaml; .ctx/GODMODE.tasks.yaml is a stale leftover and should be ignored. Persistent context lives in .ctx/memory-bank/. Subagents must run git branch --show-current before every commit and never use --no-verify. Worktree subagents must merge their branch back and remove the worktree before reporting done. Parallel subagents editing code must use isolated worktrees, not a shared checkout, to avoid one agent's commit sweeping in another agent's uncommitted edits.

documents.title: ARCHITECTURE.mbx.md
documents.raw_content: 17 workspace members (16 crates + xtask), Rust 2024 edition, workspace version 0.33.0. minibox-macros has no deps. minibox-domain has no deps. minibox-core depends on minibox-domain and minibox-macros. minibox depends on minibox-core and minibox-macros. macbox depends on minibox and minibox-core. smolbox depends on minibox and macbox. winbox depends on minibox and minibox-core. miniboxd depends on minibox, minibox-core, macbox/smolbox on unix, winbox on windows. mbx depends on minibox-core. minibox-crux-plugin depends on minibox-core. minibox-mcp depends on minibox-core. minibox-testsuite depends on minibox and minibox-core. minibox-bench depends on minibox, minibox-core, minibox-macros. minibox-cni depends on minibox-core. minibox-tui depends on minibox-core. Domain Traits (Hexagonal Ports): ImageRegistry, RegistryRouter, ImageLoader, FilesystemProvider, ResourceLimiter, ContainerRuntime, NetworkProvider, MetricsRecorder, ExecRuntime, ImagePusher, ContainerCommitter, ImageBuilder, VmCheckpoint, PtyAllocator are the primary ports wired in HandlerDependencies. All build_*_handler_dependencies functions live in crates/miniboxd/src/main.rs. Adapter selection logic is in crates/minibox-core/src/adapter_registry.rs:adapter_from_env. The protocol is JSON-over-newline on a Unix socket: 30 request variants, 29 response variants, canonical source crates/minibox-core/src/protocol.rs. DaemonResponse::ContainerOutput is non-terminal; most other response variants end request streaming. Every container run produces a persisted execution-manifest.json at {containers_base}/{id}/execution-manifest.json before the process is spawned, implemented in crates/minibox-domain/src/execution_manifest.rs:ExecutionManifest::seal(). ExecutionPolicy evaluates a manifest against a rule set, implemented in crates/minibox-domain/src/execution_policy.rs. The canonical cross-platform mocks live in minibox-core/src/adapters/mocks.rs; minibox::testing::mocks re-exports those shared doubles. Container lifecycle: CLI sends Run request via Unix socket, daemon checks image cache and pulls if missing, creates overlay mount, spawn_blocking forks child with clone(CLONE_NEWPID|NS|UTS|IPC|NET), child creates cgroup, sets limits, mounts proc/sys/tmpfs, pivot_root, closes extra FDs, execve user command. DaemonState persists container records to disk via atomic rename on every add/remove.

documents.title: FEATURE_MATRIX.mbx.md
documents.raw_content: Platform and adapter capability matrix. Linux native: full namespace/cgroup isolation, overlay FS, bridge networking. macOS: smolvm/krun adapters (run/stop/ps only, no exec/logs). GKE: unprivileged proot. Windows WSL2: scaffolded. Exec/logs missing on macOS adapters.

documents.title: GOTCHAS.mbx.md
documents.raw_content: Non-obvious patterns and gotchas. std::env::set_var/remove_var are unsafe in Rust 2024 — use static Mutex guard. minibox::testing feature-gated behind test-utils. Subprocess tests use Command::from_std with MINIBOX_TEST_BIN_DIR, never Command::cargo_bin. Platform-gated tests (#[cfg(target_os=linux)]) not compiled on macOS. cargo fmt --all rewrites untracked files. Overlays with FUSE backends downgrade to read-only silently. Container init inside CLONE_NEWNS child. Binary staleness from CARGO_TARGET_DIR.

documents.title: Minibox Whole-Project Context Map
documents.raw_content: Minibox contains the minibox-domain, minibox-core, minibox, miniboxd, mbx, macbox, smolbox, winbox, minibox-mcp, minibox-crux-plugin, minibox-tui, minibox-testsuite, and xtask components (Cargo.toml:3-20). Minibox uses hexagonal architecture with enforced minibox-domain to minibox-core to minibox dependency rings (xtask/src/architecture.rs:68-117). Minibox-core depends on minibox-domain (crates/minibox-core/Cargo.toml:32-56). Minibox depends on minibox-core (crates/minibox/Cargo.toml:50-73). Macbox depends on minibox and minibox-core (crates/macbox/Cargo.toml:11-20). Smolbox depends on minibox and macbox (crates/smolbox/Cargo.toml:8-12). Winbox depends on minibox and minibox-core (crates/winbox/Cargo.toml:8-20). Miniboxd depends on minibox and selects macbox, smolbox, or winbox platform composition (crates/miniboxd/Cargo.toml:31-52; crates/miniboxd/src/main.rs:705-785). Mbx depends on minibox-core and constructs daemon protocol requests (crates/mbx/Cargo.toml:16-18; crates/mbx/src/commands/run.rs:119-142). The daemon client uses the daemon protocol over a Unix socket (crates/minibox-core/src/client/socket.rs:30-81). The daemon server uses the daemon protocol and dispatches handler dependencies (crates/minibox/src/daemon/server.rs:243-403; crates/minibox/src/daemon/handler/mod.rs:263-282). Handler dependencies use domain ports including runtime, filesystem, image, and networking ports (crates/minibox-domain/src/runtime.rs:168-219; crates/minibox-domain/src/filesystem.rs:133-290; crates/minibox-domain/src/image.rs:38-132; crates/minibox-domain/src/networking.rs:132-219). Minibox-mcp, minibox-crux-plugin, and minibox-tui depend on minibox-core and translate operations into the daemon protocol (crates/mcp/Cargo.toml:20-34; crates/minibox-crux-plugin/Cargo.toml:16-23; crates/minibox-tui/Cargo.toml:15-21). Minibox-testsuite depends on minibox and minibox-core and implements inventory-registered conformance coverage (crates/minibox-testsuite/Cargo.toml:18-32; crates/minibox-testsuite/src/lib.rs:66-134). Xtask depends on minibox-testsuite and orchestrates quality and test gates (xtask/Cargo.toml:12-28; xtask/src/gates.rs:58-101).

documents.title: SECURITY_INVARIANTS.mbx.md
documents.raw_content: 12 security invariants pinning critical container isolation behavior. Zip slip prevention: validate_tar_entry_path rejects paths containing .. before filesystem write. Device node rejection: blocks Block/Char device nodes. Symlink rewrite: absolute symlinks converted to container-relative paths. SO_PEERCRED auth mandatory. Image pull size limits (per-layer 10GiB, aggregate 50GiB). Container init uses execve with explicit env.

documents.title: STATE_MODEL.mbx.md
documents.raw_content: DaemonState persists container metadata across daemon restarts. Held behind Arc<RwLock> for concurrent readers and exclusive writes. State persisted to JSON after every mutation via atomic rename. Container records survive restart; container state adjusted on load. Host PID conditional. Overlay mounts not reattached. Cgroup trees not reattached. Bridge IPs (in-memory only) lost. State file at MINIBOX_DATA_DIR/state.json. Atomic write protocol prevents partial writes.

Conformance suite backend-agnostic. 19 security regression tests. ~46 proptest property tests. 15 e2e daemon+CLI tests (Linux+root). 16 cgroup integration tests. Nextest-based test runner. cargo xtask test unit, test property, prepush gates.
